newsitem.title: USA: Coastal's ANR Pipeline seeks to expand.
newsitem.headline: Coastal's ANR Pipeline seeks to expand.

text.p: Coastal Corp said Tuesday its ANR Pipeline Co filed with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission seeking authorization to build and operate 37 miles of offshore and onshore pipeline looping.
The $51 milllion project would boost ANR's capacity to deliver natural gas supplies from the Gulf of Mexico.
Several new pipeline projects have been proposed to handle significant increases in gas production from new, deep-water producing regions offshore Louisiana.

ANR's Patterson Loop Expansion Project, also known as the Conch Project, would consist of offshore and onshore mainline looping. It would add up to 461 million cubic feet per day to the 1.1 billion cubic feet per day of offshore Louisiana production ANR currently delivers.

ANR said it plans to conduct an open season and to make the proposed expansion capacity available on a nondiscriminatory basis to any shipper that has executed a transportation service agreement. The open season will run from November 1, 1996 to December 3, 1996.
